overrides.value: Translates arXiv papers into Chinese through the hjfy.top service from the right-click menu and attaches the result to the item as PDF-CN; can also upload an item's PDF, and new translations need an hjfy.top login.
overrides.reason: Translated from the "这个插件是干什么的？" and "它能做什么" sections of README.md, which is in Chinese. The manifest description is half or more Chinese, and the GitHub About text, "HJFY-PDFTranslate", only repeats the name.
